title: Best Guide Ever!
text: Ricard was our guide and he is the single best guide we’ve ever had. His love for and knowledge of the Sagrada Família is amazing. We learned so much from him that we did not learn when we visited 4 years ago. We cannot speak highly enough about Ricard. He truly enjoys teaching people about the Sagrada Família and anyone who gets him as a guide is super fortunate.
author: Michael_M
